name: Minthe

source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.
scale.fallback_reason: Only one independent side direction, or near-diagonal directions make separate X/Y scales unstable.

fingerprint.description: Open industrial settlement with one HAB beside three pairs of linked tanks, a northeast PWR complex, a continuous southern LAB/IND roof, service platforms and a detached landing area to the west.

i3-hab.basis: Match to the foreground HAB with the two round roof units and the six-cylinder array behind it. One visible occupied wall band supports a schematic single storey; body height about 5.5 m is only a proportion estimate, not surveyed.

i3-power.basis: Match to the left PWR complex with a large domed reactor, broad central block and low entrance wings. Main body estimated about 8 m, one occupied storey; reactor rises above this to roughly 12 m overall. Do not uniformly extrude the whole roof to reactor height.

i3-lab-industrial.basis: Match to the rear industrial block with a square raised lab roof, pipe/duct pairs, many cylinder tops and a pair of tall exhausts. Main occupied body estimated about 7.5 m, one storey; raised roof roughly 10 m and exhausts roughly 14 m overall are low-confidence shape cues for future matching, not measured geometry.

i3-service-pad-west.basis: Low service hut beside landing area/path, estimated one storey around 3.5 m; its angular roof footprint is more reliable than its height.

i3-service-central.basis: Small isolated service hut on the central connecting path, approximately one storey; 3.5 m is a schematic module assumption.

i3-service-bottom.basis: Small detached hut beyond landing area in side view; original overhead clips its bottom edge. One storey/3.5 m is tentative and should not determine unseen footprint.

uncertain: Scale is intentionally null. All heights, raised roof levels and physical floor counts are low-confidence visual estimates from Side; basis notes are retained per building for future module matching.
LAB and IND are printed on one visibly continuous roof mass; it is recorded once with printed_labels rather than invented internal walls or separate building footprints.
The six tanks west of HAB are traced as six individual shells and three observed pairwise pipe links. No unseen cross-row connector or underground pipe is added.
Footprints follow visible main roof/structure envelopes, not surveyed ground contact. Overhangs, elevated ducts, vents and projection can displace roof edges from ground walls.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: The western landing area is clipped by the source left edge. Its centre is that of the visible portion only; neither complete pad dimensions nor size class is inferred.
The bottom service hut and its hardstand meet the map/legend crop at y874; any continuation beyond that crop is unknown.
Outdoor terminal at the western path has only a low-confidence nearest service-hut indexing association. No enclosed hut is invented at the marker.
Blue i markers are editorial Tips & tricks annotations; building links are for indexing/drawing only. Orange website information and credit controls are excluded.
Two cyan monitors visibly contain ^ and the yellow alarm text is exactly A^. Caret meanings are not defined by the supplied legend and no physical floor number is derived from them.
Small equipment rack barrels/pipes and roof cylinders are retained individually where separable. Some overlapping or steam-obscured shell detail remains low confidence.
Walkways are shown as open ground paths; no elevated bridge is inferred where the overhead and side views show no clear span.
Ships, vehicles, people, rocks, smoke/steam, projected blue landing guidance, terrain and shadows are omitted. One-pixel poles without discernible footprint are not reconstructed.
Satellite retains blue tips and yellow P/A; Icons is authoritative for complete marker transcription.

clipped_edges.notes: Landing surface extends beyond left source edge; only visible portion is traced. Centre is the visible-portion centre.
Visible hut reaches final map row before legend; no hidden continuation is reconstructed.
Hardstand shares bottom crop with service hut; only visible map-area footprint is retained.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: One medium pad next to three primary building masses forming an open courtyard.
Eight ground tanks arranged beside the HAB mass.
PWR/CMD mass carries a silver roof cap; a broad IND/LAB factory has chimney pair and multiple circular roof tanks. No separate CMD radar-dish building of the Palici layout.

pad_correspondence.size_class_basis: Current live Raven classification, confirmed by parent; local/Raven image geometry checked.
pad_correspondence.centre_override_scope: Calibration only; source centre and outline are preserved.
pad_correspondence.recorded_centre_suitable_as_target_ancho: requires exact painted-target check during calibration
pad_correspondence.centre_notes: Recorded centre is preserved. The landing target, ship and apron centroid need not coincide; use a separately verified painted-target anchor for metric fitting.

metric_template.geometry_match: high; correct fixed-building pattern and pad arrangement, independent of name field.

calibration.method: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
calibration.basis: Human-confirmed pad classes and agreed working dimensions
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.how: Pad target and matched template feature registration in independently established metre coordinates.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.name_conflict_note: Raven identity confirmed independently by parent from full gallery images. Geometry matches this template subType, whose name is swapped with the other Industrial subType in this template snapshot.
previous_calibration.range_note: Deliberate practical uncertainty envelope for template/control placement and perspective; not a confidence interval and not derived from assumed pad dimensions.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.

flags: source image needed a perspective correction (local scale 0.173-0.269 m/px)
